{"text":"MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 64GB SanDisk card fits my repeated use of memory cards and gives me a clear capacity increase, provided my devices support it.",
    "Including an adapter makes that card especially relevant because I have used both SD and microSD cards and recently added a card reader."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Fire tablet feels redundant because I already have a Fire 7, and this recommendation gives me no clear reason to replace it.",
    "Echo devices and the smart plug introduce voice control and automation that I have not been seeking; my power accessories serve practical connection needs.",
    "The streaming sticks do not match my current priorities, and 4K capability adds little value for my listed 720p TV.",
    "The earbuds and router have no clear connection to the camera, storage, and accessory needs reflected in my purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a much wider range of Amazon and Alexa devices.",
    "Owning a TV seems to have been treated as a reason to recommend several streaming devices, without a clear sign that I want one."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly choose accessories that help equipment I already own work better, including mounts, cables, memory storage, and protective holders.",
    "Compatibility matters to me: extra storage is useful only if my devices accept it, just as a lens cap or charging cable must fit the equipment I own.",
    "My recent lens-cap purchase and longer history of tripods and memory cards make camera accessories more relevant than a new smart-home setup.",
    "I interact frequently, but that does not mean I want to replace working devices or add features without a practical need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The memory card captures my interest in useful accessories, but most of the list mistakes owning electronics for wanting more connected devices."
}"}
